yourData.title: Your data
yourData.description: Download a copy of everything we have about you: your account, preferences, CV details (not the original file) and applications. See our <link>privacy notice</link>.

runner.title: Local runner
runner.description: Crawl LinkedIn, Glassdoor and Arc.dev from your own machine with your own login. Cookies never leave your computer — only the parsed job listings are uploaded.

tokens.title: Personal access tokens
tokens.description: Let your own Claude (via apps/mcp) read your feed and manage your applications. Pick only the scopes you need.

jobsRead.label: Read jobs
jobsRead.hint: Feed, job detail and live search.

applicationsWrite.label: Read & write applications
applicationsWrite.hint: List, save and update tracked applications.
